speaking_invitation_statement: Dr. Zaid Amin is available for international academic keynotes, conference plenary talks, institutional workshops, and expert panel discussions on Human-Computer Interaction, AI Governance, Cognitive Attention Systems, and Digital Ethics. To invite Dr. Amin, please contact zaid.amin@newinti.edu.my.

talks.title: The Proxy Trap in Agentic AI: Why Metric Optimization Fails Human Values
talks.event: International Symposium on Trustworthy AI and Autonomous Systems
talks.description: Delivering international keynote address on cognitive alignment, multimodal AI architectures, civic compliance modeling, and why proxy metric optimization diverges from humane values.

talks.title: Humane Interface Design: Rewiring User Attention in an Age of Viral Algorithmic Distraction
talks.description: Invited plenary discourse on epistemic attention design, cybernetic feedback loops, and empirical interface nudges against automated viral algorithmic distortion.

talks.title: Tune-Attention Model: Designing Cybernetic Interventions for Responsible Information Sharing
talks.event: 4th International Conference on Electronic and Electrical Engineering and Intelligent System (ICE3IS)
talks.role: Conference Paper Presentation & Track Session Chair
talks.description: Presented empirical research on the Tune-Attention model for curbing unreflective digital information spreading; chaired conference technical tracks.

talks.title: Digital Heritage Digitization: Reconstructing the Srivijaya Maritime Legacy
talks.event: Regional Forum on Cultural Informatics & Immersive VR
talks.description: Expert panelist and project lead demonstrating immersive 3D/VR reconstructions and digital heritage archives for the maritime kingdom of Srivijaya.
